newsitem.title: UK: Pathe Pictures seeks UK lottery film funding.
newsitem.headline: Pathe Pictures seeks UK lottery film funding.

text.p: Pathe Pictures, which has financial backing from Pathe-Cinema, Canal Plus, BZW and Coutts Bank, has applied for UK lottery funding for film projects.
Pathe Pictures groups six British producers, three European distributors and the four financial backers.
"We believe that Pathe Pictures can contribute significantly to the success of a new generation of British films here and around the world," said managing director Alexis Lloyd.

"Our application is designed to create a new kind of British independent production group: built on a solid capital base, international in its scope and devoted to making films of the highest quality," he added.
The Arts Council of England plans to award four six-year film production franchises, each of which will be backed by up to 39 million pounds of lottery funding.
Friday (today) was the closing date for applications. A decision on the award is expected by the end of May.
